## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting user-visible behavior.
Identify the backlog acceptance criterion and keep the increment reviewable.

## Verification

State the relevant normal, boundary, missingness and rejection cases, independent
expected results, before/after regression evidence where applicable, and local
source/installed-workflow results. Link the current CI run and independent review.
Keep private input paths and licensed validation receipts out of this description.

## Remaining gates

State any experimental behavior, scientific approval, annual metadata, conversion
provenance, disclosure or release work still pending. A development merge does
not promote annual support or methodological approval.
